company.name: Naytev
company.shortDescription: Naytev is based in San Francisco, and optimizes your content to drive more revenue.
company.description: Naytev optimizes how content is shared from websites to social media, creating a 30% bump in referral traffic. They use machine learning to surface and discover effective messages in real time, and prioritize those as users share.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that consolidates paid and organic social media analytics and automates workflows across multiple social networks to measure content ROI and optimize social media management.
productsAndServices.name: Unified Social Analytics and Automation Platform

productsAndServices.description: A tool for running and managing A/B tests on social media content to identify the most effective creative and messaging for Facebook and Instagram audiences.
productsAndServices.name: Social A/B Testing

productsAndServices.description: A social media scheduling tool that manages complex posting schedules across multiple profiles, time zones, and networks with live post previews and content recirculation.
productsAndServices.name: Organic Social Scheduling

productsAndServices.description: A suite for managing paid social campaigns, including boosting posts, running advanced campaigns, A/B testing ads, and optimizing for conversions on platforms like Facebook and Instagram.
productsAndServices.name: Paid Social Management and Amplification

productsAndServices.description: A free analytics service offering customizable dashboards with hundreds of paid and organic social media metrics across multiple networks.
productsAndServices.name: Free Social Media Analytics

productsAndServices.description: Tools for publishing social media content either manually or using intelligent scheduling based on rules, fanpage data, and content lifecycle.
productsAndServices.name: Content Posting Options and Intelligent Scheduler

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,023,365 to $11,803,312, a 1.47x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 6 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 1 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
